description: ASEP - Indicadores del servicio de internet desde el año 2016 al 2025e is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Estadísticas del servicio de internet recolectados anualmente, clientes residenciales, comerciales, por modalidad y tipo de tecnología, usuarios. Información recopilada desde 2016 hasta 2025 (estimado). Debido a la actualización realizada en el formulario técnico durante el año 2024, algunas tecnologías dejaron de ser solicitadas y se incorporaron nuevas. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are clientes, indicadores, internet, servicios, tecnologia. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
